text: dsh-context-picker 是面向 DSH Web 的内联上下文选择器，在输入框注册 @ 触发菜单，并通过 Host 服务保存选中的上下文引用。用户可从操作系统剪贴板选择文本或图片，也可挑选当前会话的近期用户与助手消息；其他插件还可注册 Provider 提供候选内容。选中内容会以引用形式插入消息，并在发送前由 Host 展开为文本或图片上下文。适合希望把剪贴板、近期对话或扩展来源快速加入当前提问的 DSH Web 用户。代码未配置外部服务或 API 密钥。

dsh-context-picker adds an @ menu to the DSH Web composer. Choose clipboard text or images, recent messages, or items from registered providers. Picked context is saved by the Host and added to the message before sending.
想在 DSH 输入框里用 @ 把剪贴板文字加入当前提问。
能不能从当前会话挑一条最近的用户或助手消息作为上下文？
I want to attach a clipboard image or text to my DSH prompt from the composer.
dsh-context-picker 的功能「剪贴板上下文」：在 Web 输入框输入 @ 后，可按菜单项筛选并选择剪贴板文本或 PNG、JPEG、WebP、GIF 图片；选择后将内容作为引用插入消息。
dsh-context-picker 的功能「近期消息上下文」：@ 菜单提供当前会话最近的用户与助手文本消息，选择后作为上下文引用加入消息，并在发送前由 Host 展开。

dsh-context-picker README · dsh-context-picker：An extensible inline context picker for DeepSeek Harness. Type `@` in the composer to pick clipboard text, clipboard images, recent DSH messages, or contexts contributed by another plugin such as the active `dsh-file-manager` Monaco selection.

The result is an atomic reference chip that can be mixed with normal prose. This is an additive standalone DSH Bundle: it neither patches Harness source nor replaces the built-in file/session reference source.

Clipboard data can originate in another process or application because the Web client uses the operating-system Clipboard API. Browser security still controls access. Merely opening the menu does not upload clipboard data: a candidate stays in browser memory until the user picks it.

dsh-context-picker README · Development：Context-source plugins implement the public `dsh-context-picker/provider` contract and optionally register with `ctx.contextPicker`. They do not depend on composer internals, durable reference grammar, storage, or model-message assembly. See the [architecture and Provider contract](docs/architecture.md) and the [Chinese guide](README.zh.md).
